0022600130.text: The San Antonio Spurs (1-2, 0-2 at home) host the Sacramento Kings (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) in the Spurs' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Spurs 9th in the West and 2.5 games back in fourth place in the Southwest, while the Kings sit 15th in the West and 3 games back in fifth place in the Pacific. The Spurs won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season 3-0, most recently a 132-104 win in Sacramento on March 17, 2026, and the two teams have not yet played each other in 2026-27. The Spurs will be without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and the Kings will be without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated).
